body: remarkCodeMeta (packages/mdx-viewer/src/remark-code-meta.ts) copies a fence's meta string into node.data.hProperties['data-meta'] because react-markdown/mdast-util-to-hast drops the info-string after the lang. EVERY custom code handler (csv/datagrid/kanban/chart/schema/mindmap) reads data-meta to parse CLI-style flags. Removing/altering this plugin silently breaks all fenced-block options.
